why: Searches surface only pre-2024 work: the 2010 Kühn–Mycroft–Osthus proof for large n, and 2021-2023 bound improvements (Dross–Havet, leaf-count variants); nothing post-January-2024 addresses the remaining finitely many small oriented trees or the conjecture itself. Hits on 'Gyárfás–Sumner conjecture' are a different, unrelated conjecture.
